reference.solution:
Method 1: Real numbers and number-line points

Points on the number line represent both rational and irrational numbers, and real numbers correspond one-to-one with points on the number line. Real numbers are divided into three categories: positive real numbers, \(0\), and negative real numbers. \(0\) is rational.
